I’d also wish for her to have really dark brown hair that’s hitting close to looking black but isn’t entirely there. 

Saori from Oreimo is a character I admire because of her swirly glasses, and I wish for my character to have her exact glasses as well. (I want the glasses to be hanging on the nose where they’re still wearing them, but you could still see their eyes slightly.)

As for the clothing, I want my character to be wearing something similar to the school uniform Hinata wears from Wataten, including the thigh highs. Her having blue colour nails and acting/posing being moe would be nice as well.

Height: 155cm
